Ledian

Bug Flying

Johto · Generation 2

Ledian is a Bug/Flying-type Five Star Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 35.6 kg. It evolves from Ledyba. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (110), with a base stat total of 390.
